model: YOLOv8n fine-tuned on LOCO (Logistics Objects in Context)
eval_split: LOCO subset 4 — scene-separated held-out test (no cross-scene leakage)

small_load_carrier.note: absent in held-out scene (subset 4) — not evaluable

analysis: Aggregate mAP@0.5 = 0.22 is dominated by a severe class imbalance: pallet accounts for 78.4% of training instances, while stillage / pallet_truck / forklift are rare. The detector is strong on the well-represented pallet class (mAP@0.5 = 0.55) and degrades on rare classes. The held-out scene (subset 4) contains no small_load_carrier instances, so that class is not evaluable on this split. This is an honest, imbalance-limited result, not a training failure.
